title: Clone outcome
statement: Let $E$ be a weighted constraint experiment over a constraint template with predicate family $[0m[0m\Psi$ and outcome space $\mathrm{Outcome}(E)$. For a natural number $M$, a clone outcome is a pair consisting of an experiment outcome and a choice of a label in $\text{Fin}(M)$ for each query position of the predicate selected by that outcome.
